subject.title: fix(models): preserve audio and video input modalities

question: Should this broader branch become the canonical landing path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97048 after real loader proof, or should its extra preservation coverage be ported into the proof-positive sibling?
rationale: The code path fix is concrete, but multiple same-root PRs exist and the permanent breadth of the provider model input metadata contract is maintainer-owned compatibility scope.

options.title: Make this broader branch canonical after proof
options.body: Require current-head generated-catalog loader proof here, then use this branch because it preserves audio/video across more downstream catalog and listing surfaces.

options.title: Port broader coverage into the proof-positive sibling
options.body: Move this branch's catalog-core, discovery, and static-catalog preservation into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97252 and make that PR canonical instead.

options.title: Reject widening and clamp generated catalogs
options.body: Pause the widening PRs and replace them with generated-catalog normalization that drops unsupported modalities before registry validation.

recommendation.title: Make this broader branch canonical after proof
recommendation.body: Require current-head generated-catalog loader proof here, then use this branch because it preserves audio/video across more downstream catalog and listing surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has recent adjacent history in model catalog and LLM contract surfaces.
